# <span id="aanchor237"></span> Close Dates Editor

The Close Dates Editor displays the following close status information for a specified meter:

- Months for which the meter is closed
- Whether the meter is still closed or has been reopened
- Whether PPAs have been applied
- The start and end of the closed month
- When the month was last closed or opened
- Who last closed or opened the meter for that month

<div class="procedure">

To view meter close dates:

1.  Go to **Setup** \> **Meter** \> **Close Dates**.
2.  Select a meter number or meter name from the drop-down menu.
3.  To view data for the meter for a range of months, select **Contract Month** and select the time frame to be displayed; otherwise, select **All Dates**.
4.  Click **Refresh**.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 597;height: 175;" />

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Considerations">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Meter Close Date Considerations</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Considerations">

Once a meter’s information is displayed in the editor, if a month has been closed, but no PPAs have been applied, the user can select the row for that month and click Open Data. This will open the month and any edits to the data will be saved as regular edits, not as PPAs. Who opened the data and when they opened it will be recorded and displayed under Open/Closed By and Open/Closed On, respectively.

If a meter has been opened for a month, it can be closed by selecting the row for that month and clicking Close Data. This will close the month and any edits to the data will be saved as PPAs. The meter can only be closed for the month in this manner if it was already previously closed and subsequently opened. Who closed the data and when they closed it will be recorded and displayed under Open/Closed By and Open/Closed On, respectively.

By default, any meter can be closed as long as the user has appropriate permissions (see: [User Access](../Settings%20Manager/Security/User%20Access.md)).

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Disallow Closing of Meters">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Disallow Closing of Meters</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Disallow Closing of Meters">

<div class="procedure">

To disallow the closing of meters:

1.  Go to the [Meter Editor Reports tab](../Meters/Meter%20Editor/Reports%20Tab.md).
2.  Set the "Skip Closing Data" option to "Yes".
3.  Return to the Meter Data Close Dates Editor. "Disallowed" will display under the "Closes of this Meter are" label.
4.  To override this setting, click the **OK** button under "Change?".

This setting will not impact data that has already been closed.

</div>

</div>
